This edition is organised into four thematic parts: Part 1. From international discussions on the changing role of libraries to practical approaches for evaluating AI-generated information, these contributions address questions of trust, evidence, and responsible information use. Part 2. Information Literacy Education and Learning Design Part Two – Information Literacy Education and Learning Design presents innovative approaches to teaching and learning across educational settings. Topics include curriculum development, university library orientation, AI-assisted career preparation, cultural heritage projects, international school collaboration, and practical data literacy activities. title: datasette-maplibre 0.1a0
raw_text: Release: datasette-maplibre 0.1a0 The first new Datasette geospatial plugin in quite a while! This one combines the excellent MapLibre GL library with OpenFreeMap , the free vector map server operated by Zsolt Ero (you should sponsor Zsolt on GitHub .) I built most of this with a single prompt to Claude Fable 5.2: Look at datasette-cluster-map and datasette-leaflet-geojson plugins, then look at ~/dev/tools/openfreemap-demo.html - then build a brand new Datasette plugin that uses maplibreGL and openfreemap and combines the features of those other two plugins - but be creative and think outside the box for other useful features the plugin might have "Be creative and think outside the box" resulted in a few neat ideas - my favorite is that it displays SVG previews of GeoJSON shapes, then loads a WebGL preview only when they scroll into view. I also had Claude build a comprehensive demo which works in the latest Datasette Lite, so you can visit this link to load the plugin and a demo database in your browser via Pyodide and WebAssembly. title: datasette 1.0a43
raw_text: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers - the built-in TSV and CSV export mechanisms now use this as well, and plugins can register themselves as capable of streaming every row in a table in one go via the new Response.stream() method. There are a couple of security fixes, one of which I deemed deserving of a GitHub advisory : private stored queries could be exposed, granting access to the title and SQL of the query (but not allowing that query to be executed). There are dozens of smaller improvements. The row page JSON representation finally has a design suitable for 1.0 . A new <datasette-copy-button> Web Component provides copy-schema in various places. JSON in columns on the row page can be pretty-printed. There's a new DatasetteModal.confirm() JavaScript utility method. Plus dozens of bug fixes, including contributions by Zihan Dai , Peter Olkhovets , Ilya Khalafi , and Ankita Advitot . The feature I'm most excited about is a pretty tiny one: I've added CSS multi-page view transitions to Datasette! title: Report From Utah: Voters Just Ousted The Republican Representative Behind The State’s Sweeping School Book Ban Law
raw_text: From The Salt Lake Tribune: The Republican representative behind Utah’s statewide school book ban law was ousted last week. Rep. Ken Ivory, R-West Jordan, lost his race against Democrat Drew Howells, who secured 58.11% of the vote as of Friday morning. Ivory received about 41.89%. He acknowledged the defeat in a recent Facebook post. Two years ago, Ivory sponsored Utah’s sensitive materials law. It requires a book to be removed from all public schools in the state if at least three school districts (or at least two districts and five charter schools) determine it amounts to “objective sensitive material” — pornographic or otherwise indecent content, as defined by state code. [Clip] Since then, a total of 44 books have been banned from all Utah public schools. Once a title lands on the list, school districts must destroy all copies. Nearly all of those 44 bans have been driven by just two school districts: Davis and Washington County . Davis is home to a prominent book ban advocate, Brooke Stephens, who shares a connection with Ivory. Learn More, Read the Complete Article The post Report From Utah: Voters Just Ousted The Republican Representative Behind The State’s Sweeping School Book Ban Law appeared first on Library Journal infoDOCKET .

title: datasette-apps 0.4a0
raw_text: Release: datasette-apps 0.4a0 Datasette Apps are sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that live inside Datasette - think Claude Artifacts, but these ones can run SQL queries against your data. 0.4a0 adds support for linking: you can link to an app with #fragments in the URL and the app can see and use those, plus supported URL schemes are reported back to Datasette Agent so it can help write apps that link to each other. This means you can have e.g. an app that shows details about a specific record, and a completely separate app that searches those records and links to their representations in the first app. Tags: datasette-agent , datasette-apps , datasette , urls

title: Delivery drones are coming. For some with PTSD, that's a terrifying prospect.
raw_text: In August, Amazon announced plans to expand its Prime Air delivery drone program to “ nearly 500 cities and towns by the end of 2026 ." Combined with similar uncrewed aerial delivery programs from DoorDash and Zipline (in partnership with Uber and Walmart), the expansion suggests that flying robots dropping their payloads onto suburban lawns will soon be commonplace. For many people, delivery drones will be little more than a novelty, occasionally good for a laugh when one does something ridiculous. For others, though, their growing use could be a nightmare. As the instant delivery industry clears the last FAA hurdles to rapid deliveries beyond an operator's line of sight, an increasing number of people worldwide are living with post-traumatic stress disorder or other anxiety-related disorders triggered by drones. The use of all manner of weaponized drones in the ongoing war in Ukraine and in Israeli attacks on Lebanon and Gaza has already produced an epidemic of what some mental health professionals have dubbed “dronophobia. ” And while relatively few US troops have been targeted by drones flown by Iran, ISIS, and Iran-backed militias throughout the Middle East, even those who have not directly been attacked may experience anxiety simply because of the ample video footage of attacks circulating in news and social media. Vulcan rocket fails during launch, dealing major blow to SpaceX competitors
raw_text: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan rocket and 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites fell back to Earth minutes after liftoff Sunday, a crushing setback that will ripple across all sectors of the US space industry. The Vulcan rocket is on contract to launch roughly half of the US military's national security space missions in the next few years, and Sunday's mission was the first of 38 Vulcan launches booked by Amazon to build out its network of broadband Internet satellites aimed at competing with SpaceX's Starlink. Sunday's failure is expected to ground the rocket for an indefinite period of time. Vulcan is no stranger to close calls, having overcome failures with its strap-on solid rocket boosters on two of its four previous flights. In each case, the rocket corrected for those problems and continued into orbit to deploy its payloads. The incidents trigged months-long reviews and investigations before ULA could resume Vulcan flights. Read full article Comments

title: Spionage, smokkel en ontslag: de driedubbele crisis bij ai-gigant Nvidia
raw_text: De affaire rond Nvidia-topman Jensen Huang, die afgelopen donderdag werd ontslagen wegens een liefdesrelatie met een vermeende Chinese spionne, kan voor Nvidia verstrekkende gevolgen hebben. De leidende leverancier van geavanceerde ai-chips heeft niet alleen zijn charismatische en uiterst succesvolle topman verloren , maar dreigt ook een belangrijk afzetgebied te verliezen. Ook de ai-wereld schudt op zijn grondvesten. In Silicon Valley probeert een groep prominente ondernemers uit de tech-industrie de Board te bewegen tot het terugdraaien van het ontslag. Ook de hoofdrolspeler zelf wil wel weer terug in het pluche bij Nvidia. Maar de regering in Washington heeft daar moeite mee. Met medeweten van Jensen Huang heeft Nvidia immers een wijdvertakt netwerk van merendeels Aziatische bedrijven opgebouwd dat China aan de meest felbegeerde ai-chips hielp. In aanvulling op die smokkel leverden veel datacenters buiten China de rekenkracht waarmee de Chinezen hun ai-modellen konden testen en draaien. Het op afstand gebruiken van datacenters in Maleisië en in mindere mate in Indonesië, eigenlijk grote ai-fabrieken, blijkt een enorme vlucht te hebben genomen.
